decision.reason: Explicit approval 2026-10-28; PAnimatable is the replacement.
PiP submission now occurs after native target/projection selection. The old immediate dispatcher wrapper and its abstract constructor are replaced by scoped native PiP execution and failure discard.
Inventory previews use native PictureInPictureRenderer.prepare/renderToTexture and the same GUI scope. The old immediate inventory injection and abstract constructor are replaced.
WORLD enters at native GameRenderer.renderLevel. The native framegraph pass guarantees endWorldFrame in finally after the transparency inputs are consumed.
PostChain.process(float) is replaced by native framegraph transparency declarations. LevelRenderer retains five targets and PWorldRenderPass composites before their retirement.

Shared extraction/feature/submit hooks own armor provider selection, visibility, animation and frozen geometry on both loaders; the old immediate Fabric-only injection and abstract constructor are replaced.

Fabric LevelRenderEvents route opaque/translucent/particle boundaries; shared framegraph integration resolves the actual weather/Fabulous targets. The old immediate stage injection and abstract constructor are replaced.
AtlasRegistry.register(AtlasConfig) replaces mutation of the removed AtlasSet constructor mapping. Both typed metadata records are registered with the native atlas.

VertexBuffer and its six mutable index/upload accessors were removed. Native geometry is replaced atomically with PGlDynamicGeometry.update(PGeometryData), and native arena pages/rings own GPU storage. No independently mutable fake index fields are introduced.

The additional RS generic binds layer replay to the parent renderer snapshot. Existing per-bone context hooks and geometry-only submission remain active.
